cover_headline: Jailer 2 Hindi Earns Rs 43.8 Crore in 15 Days, Books 68% Profit Over Breakeven
facts: The Hindi dubbed version has earned Rs 43.8 crore net in India in 15 days, against a breakeven target of Rs 26 crore — a profit of Rs 17.8 crore, or 68.46 percent, according to Koimoi
Across all languages, the film's India net total reached Rs 429.55 crore and its worldwide gross Rs 766.65 crore after 15 days, according to Sacnilk
The Hindi version needs Rs 52 crore net for a hit verdict on Koimoi's parameters, with about six days of open run before Ramayana Part One releases

end.headline: Jailer 2 Hindi Earns Rs 43.8 Crore in 15 Days, Books 68% Profit Over Breakeven
end.line: Rajinikanth's Tamil film, released in Hindi dubbed version on October 15, has crossed its Rs 26 crore breakeven with Rs 17.8 crore in profit, Koimoi reported.
